# test_fizzbuzz.py

import pytest

from your_module import fizzbuzz  # replace "your_module" with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("n", "expected"),
    [
        # Happy path: multiples of 15
        (15, "FizzBuzz"),
        (30, "FizzBuzz"),
        (45, "FizzBuzz"),

        # Happy path: multiples of 3 only
        (3, "Fizz"),
        (6, "Fizz"),
        (99, "Fizz"),

        # Happy path: multiples of 5 only
        (5, "Buzz"),
        (10, "Buzz"),
        (100, "Buzz"),

        # Happy path: non-multiples of 3 or 5
        (1, "1"),
        (2, "2"),
        (4, "4"),
        (7, "7"),
    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_happy_path(n, expected):
    assert fizzbuzz(n) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("n", "expected"),
    [
        # Edge case: zero is divisible by 15
        (0, "FizzBuzz"),

        # Edge case: negative multiples
        (-15, "FizzBuzz"),
        (-30, "FizzBuzz"),
        (-3, "Fizz"),
        (-6, "Fizz"),
        (-5, "Buzz"),
        (-10, "Buzz"),

        # Edge case: negative non-multiples
        (-1, "-1"),
        (-2, "-2"),
        (-7, "-7"),
    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_edge_cases(n, expected):
    assert fizzbuzz(n) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "invalid_input",
    [
        None,
        "15",
        [],
        {},
        object(),
    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_invalid_input_raises_type_error(invalid_input):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        fizzbuzz(invalid_input)
